summary: OpenAI announced that MUFG has deployed ChatGPT Enterprise to about 35,000 employees at Mitsubishi UFJ Bank and is partnering with OpenAI on AI-native transformation across banking and retail customer experiences, including future integration of OpenAI technology into MUFG's digital bank, WealthNavi, and Moneytree.

mechanisms.reason: A large enterprise deployment of ChatGPT seats across tens of thousands of employees, plus thousands of custom GPTs built on top, represents a meaningful increase in aggregate usage of the model.
mechanisms.quote: MUFG has deployed ChatGPT Enterprise to approximately 35,000 employees at Mitsubishi UFJ Bank

categories.reason: A major bank and its wealth management and robo-advisory subsidiaries are integrating OpenAI technology into customer-facing financial products and internal operations.
categories.quote: MUFG, including WealthNavi, plans to use OpenAI technology in the digital bank at the center of emutt, its integrated financial services brand.
